description: Three managers: the Python package (pyproject.toml and uv.lock), the UI (ui/package.json and its lockfile), and GitHub Actions. Every update is a pull request the golden tests gate. Lock-file refreshes stay off (the shared default): npm cannot hold a refresh to the 14-day wait. uv can, with exclude-newer (exempting NimbleBrain's own packages through exclude-newer-package), but only once every other upload-time in uv.lock is at least 14 days old, or turning it on would downgrade those packages. Turning it on also needs a root constraint-dependencies pin on nimblebrain-server-sdk at the locked version, or a refresh moves the SDK away from the bundle's constraint and tests/test_mcpb.py fails.

packageRules.description: The bundle's project pins the released todosforagents to the package's own version and constrains the SDK to uv.lock's (tests/test_mcpb.py), so it moves with a release or an SDK bump, never on its own.

Golden tests hold the wire contracts nimblebrain-server-sdk and pgkeyset produce, and SQLAlchemy is held below 2.1 because 2.1 changes the search SQL paging.txt freezes. pgkeyset is pinned exactly; the SDK is held to a minor range and uv.lock picks its version, which the bundle's constraint in mcpb/pyproject.toml must equal, so an SDK bump edits that file in the same pull request. A bump of any of them is a deliberate, reviewed change, never part of a group.
